summary: Mobile-only frontend parity verification for PageIntro default-expanded behavior + full intro anatomy on the 8 target screens. Logged in as cathy@example.com and hit each route on the Expo web preview. All 8 target screens render the eyebrow + H1 + description + three info cards (WHAT THIS DOES / HOW TO USE IT / WHAT YOU GET) visible on load without tapping. The 'How this works' toggle still works — verified on /upload (open -> collapsed -> open). Ask Wayly empty-state now scrolls and shows the full PageIntro above the suggestions; sending a message hides the intro and switches to the chat list (message 'hello' visible, 'Wayly is thinking…' typing indicator shown). Regression sweep on 10 previously-working intro screens: all render intro + toggle without red-screen or layout overflow (screens that only pass whatItDoes still show only the WHAT THIS DOES card by design — those are unchanged prop shapes, not a regression).
critical_code_review_comments: PageIntro (/app/mobile/src/components/PageIntro.tsx:22): useState(true) correctly makes cards default-open matching web. The 'How this works' Pressable still toggles state — good.

Consider hiding the 'How this works' toggle when cards are open by default (or renaming to 'Hide details' when open) to avoid the affordance suggesting hidden content that is already visible. Not blocking — web PageIntro behaves the same way.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (8/8 intro parity targets + toggle + Ask send-flow + 10 regression screens all pass)

seed_data_creation: None — used existing participant Mum data (decoded statements, 50 open cases, existing switch row).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Per-target verification on https://mobile-exact-parity.expo.preview.emergentagent.com: /budget-scenarios ✓, /reports ✓ (empty state shows StatePanel; after generate the FlatList header renders PageIntro — verified by direct route load which shows all 3 cards), /provider-switch ✓ (new eyebrow 'Provider Switches' + title 'Managing a Provider Switch, End-to-End'), /cases ✓ (new 'Open Complaints and Resolutions'), /contribution-position ✓ (has decoded statement for Mum, shows 'Where You Stand on Contributions'), /classification-prep ✓, /upload ✓ (source pickers still visible after intro), /(tabs)/ask ✓ (empty state scrolls, intro above suggestions; send 'hello' correctly switches to chat FlatList and shows 'Wayly is thinking…'). Toggle test confirmed on /upload: cards visible → click page-intro-toggle → cards collapsed → click again → cards expanded. Regression: statements-tab, invoices, letters, documents, care-plans, athm, chsp-tools, carer-self-check, compare-providers, family-tab — all load without red-screen. Some (documents, care-plans, athm, compare-providers) only expose the WHAT THIS DOES card because those screens' PageIntro calls only pass `whatItDoes` — this is a screen-level content choice, not a PageIntro bug.
